title: No API-dataset connector class: connectors are file-tree-shaped only
wanted_capability: A connector profile for typed API datasets (Xero, Slack, and similar business systems): producer-side observation with named checkpoint sets, deterministic projection of accepted observations into connector-owned source graphs, declared targeted actions with typed inputs and placement policy, and status surfaces, so remote business systems become corpus-inspectable without forcing their domain objects into file trees or blackbox core types. The file-tree profile (remote store to manifest plus blobs over the collector wire) covers documents only; API datasets need semantic projection and action surfaces. Tracked by design/connectors/reflective-graph-connector-program.md.
